_comment: How fast and how bouncy minions (Generals, Support Slime, Ancient Treant) move on the map. speedScale multiplies every unit's baseSpeed; all speed bonuses (upgrades, buffs, blessings, weather, skills) multiply together and are clamped to [bonusFloor, bonusCap] so stacked buffs never turn units into blurs. Gait values are pixel heights / scale changes of the walking bob (WorkerManager.syncMinionSprite); walkFps is the walk-cycle frame rate.
